target: observe_push.sh — OpenObserve answers a discarded batch with HTTP 200 and failed>0 in the body; the cursor must NOT advance on that (the silent-loss bug)
cmd:
mkdir -p .agentic/observability bin; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true,"stack":{"enabled":true}}}' > .agentic/config.json; printf '%s
' '{"v":1,"ts":"2026-07-28T09:01:00Z","event":"shim_call","run_id":"r1"}' > .agentic/observability/events-20260728.jsonl; printf '#!/bin/sh
printf "%%s" "{\"code\":200,\"status\":[{\"name\":\"agentic\",\"successful\":0,\"failed\":1,\"error\":\"Too old data, only last 5 hours data can be ingested. Data discarded.\"}]}"
exit 0
' > bin/curl-reject; printf '#!/bin/sh
printf "%%s" "{\"code\":200,\"status\":[{\"name\":\"agentic\",\"successful\":1,\"failed\":0}]}"
exit 0
' > bin/curl-accept; chmod +x bin/curl-reject bin/curl-accept; export O2_URL=http://localhost:5080 O2_AUTH=a:b; O2_CURL="$PWD/bin/curl-reject" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_push.sh" >/dev/null 2>err.txt; REJ_EC=$?; HELD="$(jq -r '.["events-20260728.jsonl"] // 0' .agentic/observability/state/push-cursor.json)"; O2_CURL="$PWD/bin/curl-accept" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_push.sh" >/dev/null; ADV="$(jq -r '.["events-20260728.jsonl"] // 0' .agentic/observability/state/push-cursor.json)"; jq -n --argjson ec "$REJ_EC" --argjson h "$HELD" --argjson a "$ADV" --arg err "$(cat err.txt)" '{ec: $ec, held: $h, advanced: $a, said_too_old: ($err | test("Too old data"))}'

provenance.note: 582 events were marked pushed while the store discarded every one of them
